title: in fleet mode there is no initial prompt, so the card at the top of the brief file the session reads carries ROUTE-SCOPE:
source: intended: PLAN.md defect S1; fleet mode passes no prompt (adapters/claude.ts), so brief.md is what carries the scope
intent: INTENDED behavior (defect S1, route_scope). The router reads a scope with the regex (?:^|[.!?])[ \t>*-]*ROUTE-SCOPE:([^\n]*), so the card line must start with ROUTE-SCOPE: (with the colon, at a line start or after . ! ?) and list the build ids comma separated. In fleet mode no prompt reaches claude, so .jitso/launches/<id>/brief.md (card first, then the brief) is the carrier: it must have a line starting with 'ROUTE-SCOPE: code-quickref,ticket-work'.
